exampleDetails.english: Running three thousand meters for him is just like walking, equally easy.

exampleTranslations: Hualien's seaside is just like his country's seaside, equally pretty.
Mobile phones are just like computers, equally convenient.
Running three thousand meters for him is just like walking, equally easy.
explanation: Expresses similarity or “as…as…” equivalence. Can compare nouns (像…一樣) or degree (像…一樣 + adj). Negation: 不像…那麼…／不跟…一樣…

pinyin: jí le / de bùdéliǎo / de hěn

exampleDetails.pinyin: zhè xiē cài hǎo chī jí le。
exampleDetails.english: These dishes are delicious to the extreme (extremely delicious).

exampleDetails.pinyin: wǒ è dé bù dé le。
exampleDetails.english: I am hungry terribly (terribly hungry).

exampleDetails.pinyin: hūn lǐ qì fēn rè nào dé hěn。
exampleDetails.english: The wedding atmosphere was lively indeed (very lively).

exampleTranslations: These dishes are delicious to the extreme (extremely delicious).
I am hungry terribly (terribly hungry).
The wedding atmosphere was lively indeed (very lively).
explanation: Intensifier patterns for strong degree. Often used in spoken emphasis. Structure: Adj + 極了 or Adj/ V + 得 + 很/不得了.

examples: 雖然房租不便宜，我還租得起。
這家店的東西大家都吃得起。

exampleDetails.pinyin: fáng zi tài guì， wǒ mǎi bù qǐ。
exampleDetails.english: The house is too expensive, I cannot afford to buy [it].

exampleDetails.chinese: 雖然房租不便宜，我還租得起。
exampleDetails.pinyin: suī rán fáng zū bù biàn yí， wǒ hái zū dé qǐ。
exampleDetails.english: Although the rent is not cheap, I can still afford to rent [it].

exampleDetails.chinese: 這家店的東西大家都吃得起。
exampleDetails.pinyin: zhè jiā diàn de dōng xī dà jiā dōu chī dé qǐ。
exampleDetails.english: Things at this shop, everyone can afford to eat.

exampleTranslations: The house is too expensive, I cannot afford to buy [it].
Although the rent is not cheap, I can still afford to rent [it].
Things at this shop, everyone can afford to eat.
explanation: Potential complement meaning “afford” (money/expense/effort). Negation: V不起. Common with 買／租／付／用. Questions: 租得起嗎？買得起嗎？

pointZh: V 出來（看／聽／吃／算出來…）
english: figure out; make out; discern (result becomes clear)
examples: 你要看久一點才看得出來是誰。
我聽得出來他在講台語。
我吃不出來裡面有什麼料。

exampleDetails.chinese: 你要看久一點才看得出來是誰。
exampleDetails.pinyin: nǐ yào kàn jiǔ yī diǎn cái kàn dé chū lái shì shuí。
exampleDetails.english: You need to look a bit longer, only then can [you] tell who it is.

exampleDetails.chinese: 我聽得出來他在講台語。
exampleDetails.pinyin: wǒ tīng dé chū lái tā zài jiǎng tái yǔ。
exampleDetails.english: I can discern [by listening] that he is speaking Taiwanese.

exampleDetails.chinese: 我吃不出來裡面有什麼料。
exampleDetails.pinyin: wǒ chī bù chū lái lǐ miàn yǒu shén me liào。
exampleDetails.english: I cannot taste out what ingredients are inside.

exampleTranslations: You need to look a bit longer, only then can [you] tell who it is.
I can discern [by listening] that he is speaking Taiwanese.
I cannot taste out what ingredients are inside.
explanation: Result complement 出來 means the result “emerges” from perception/thinking. Common: 看得出來／聽得出來／吃得出來／想得出來／算得出來／寫得出來. Negation often: 看不出來／想不出來.

pointZh: V 下（裝得下／坐得下／放得下…）
examples: 這個教室坐不下那麼多人。
這個隨身碟裝得下這些照片嗎？

exampleDetails.pinyin: zhè tái chē zuò dé xià jiǔ gè rén。
exampleDetails.english: This car can seat nine people.

exampleDetails.chinese: 這個教室坐不下那麼多人。
exampleDetails.pinyin: zhè gè jiào shì zuò bù xià nà me duō rén。
exampleDetails.english: This classroom cannot seat that many people.

exampleDetails.chinese: 這個隨身碟裝得下這些照片嗎？
exampleDetails.pinyin: zhè gè suí shēn dié zhuāng dé xià zhè xiē zhào piān ma？
exampleDetails.english: Can this flash drive fit these photos?

exampleTranslations: This car can seat nine people.
This classroom cannot seat that many people.
Can this flash drive fit these photos?
explanation: Complement 下 indicates capacity to accommodate (space/volume). Often with 坐／放／裝／塞／住. Negation: V不下.

english: do something briefly first; “take a quick…”
examples: 把那本書看一看，再告訴我好不好。
把錢數一數再去繳學費。
把上課方式說一說給新同學聽。

exampleDetails.chinese: 把那本書看一看，再告訴我好不好。
exampleDetails.pinyin: bǎ nà běn shū kàn yī kàn， zài gào sù wǒ hǎo bù hǎo。
exampleDetails.english: Take a look at that book, then tell me if it is good.

exampleDetails.chinese: 把錢數一數再去繳學費。
exampleDetails.pinyin: bǎ qián shù yī shù zài qù jiǎo xué fèi。
exampleDetails.english: Count the money a bit, then go pay the tuition fee.

exampleDetails.chinese: 把上課方式說一說給新同學聽。
exampleDetails.pinyin: bǎ shàng kè fāng shì shuō yī shuō gěi xīn tóng xué tīng。
exampleDetails.english: Explain the class format a bit for the new classmates to hear.

exampleTranslations: Take a look at that book, then tell me if it is good.
Count the money a bit, then go pay the tuition fee.
Explain the class format a bit for the new classmates to hear.
explanation: 把 + verb reduplication softens the tone and suggests “do it a bit / do it first.” Often used with sequencing: 先…再…. Common patterns: 看一看／想一想／問一問／查一查／數一數.

pointZh: 把 + 結果補語（洗乾淨／吃完／關上…）
english: dispose of object to a clear result

exampleDetails.pinyin: bǎ gāo lì cài xǐ qián jìng。
exampleDetails.english: Wash the cabbage clean.

exampleDetails.pinyin: bǎ chuāng hù guān shàng， gāi zǒu le。
exampleDetails.english: Close the window, [we] ought to leave.

exampleDetails.pinyin: bǎ tāng hē wán le ma？
exampleDetails.english: Have [you] finished drinking the soup?

exampleTranslations: Wash the cabbage clean.
Close the window, [we] ought to leave.
Have [you] finished drinking the soup?
explanation: 把 sentence highlighting the object being affected + a result complement. Structure: 把 + 受詞 + V + 結果 (e.g., 弄壞／洗好／吃完／包好／關上／寫完). Negation: 不要把…V完／還沒把…V好.

english: take advantage of; seize the moment
examples: 趁這週末有空，去東海岸走走。
趁老師還沒來，出去買咖啡。
趁天氣好，去河濱公園騎車。

exampleDetails.chinese: 趁這週末有空，去東海岸走走。
exampleDetails.pinyin: chèn zhè zhōu mò yǒu kòng， qù dōng hǎi àn zǒu zǒu。
exampleDetails.english: Taking advantage of having free time this weekend, go walk along the east coast.

exampleDetails.chinese: 趁老師還沒來，出去買咖啡。
exampleDetails.pinyin: chèn lǎo shī hái méi lái， chū qù mǎi kā fēi。
exampleDetails.english: Taking advantage of the teacher not having arrived yet, go out to buy coffee.

exampleDetails.chinese: 趁天氣好，去河濱公園騎車。
exampleDetails.pinyin: chèn tiān qì hǎo， qù hé bīn gōng yuán qí chē。
exampleDetails.english: Taking advantage of the good weather, go ride a bicycle at the riverside park.

exampleTranslations: Taking advantage of having free time this weekend, go walk along the east coast.
Taking advantage of the teacher not having arrived yet, go out to buy coffee.
Taking advantage of the good weather, go ride a bicycle at the riverside park.
explanation: Means “while there’s a chance/while a condition holds.” Pattern: 趁 + 時間/狀態 + 行動. Often implies acting promptly before the chance disappears.

pinyin: qítā de / bié de / lìngwài de
examples: 他去過花蓮，沒去過其他的地方。
我不吃牛肉，我們點別的吧。
這份工作太遠，我想找另外的工作。

exampleDetails.chinese: 他去過花蓮，沒去過其他的地方。
exampleDetails.pinyin: tā qù guò huā lián， méi qù guò qí tā de dì fāng。
exampleDetails.english: He has been to Hualien, [but] has not been to other places.

exampleDetails.chinese: 我不吃牛肉，我們點別的吧。
exampleDetails.pinyin: wǒ bù chī niú ròu， wǒ men diǎn bié de ba。
exampleDetails.english: I do not eat beef, let's order something else.

exampleDetails.chinese: 這份工作太遠，我想找另外的工作。
exampleDetails.pinyin: zhè fèn gōng zuò tài yuǎn， wǒ xiǎng zhǎo lìng wài de gōng zuò。
exampleDetails.english: This job is too far, I want to look for another job.

exampleTranslations: He has been to Hualien, [but] has not been to other places.
I do not eat beef, let's order something else.
This job is too far, I want to look for another job.
explanation: 其他的 = “the other(s)” (within a known group). 別的 = “another/different one.” 另外的 = “an additional/another separate one.” Often used before nouns: 其他的地方／別的東西／另外的工作.

english: verb classifiers (once, time, trip, from start to finish)

exampleDetails.pinyin: tā dǎ le wǒ yī xià。
exampleDetails.english: He hit me once.

exampleDetails.pinyin: wǒ qù guò tài guó liǎng tàng。
exampleDetails.english: I have been to Thailand for two trips.

exampleDetails.pinyin: wǒ kàn le nà bù diàn yǐng sān cì。
exampleDetails.english: I watched that movie three times.

exampleTranslations: He hit me once.
I have been to Thailand for two trips.
I watched that movie three times.
explanation: Verb classifiers measure frequency or completeness of actions. 下 = light/brief action; 趟 = round trip; 遍 = from beginning to end; 次 = general occurrence. Structure: V + 次數 + 動量詞.

examples: 我們先去台中，然後去墾丁。
後來我發現太極很有趣。
以後我一定會騎腳踏車。

exampleDetails.chinese: 我們先去台中，然後去墾丁。
exampleDetails.pinyin: wǒ men xiān qù tái zhōng， rán hòu qù kěn dīng。
exampleDetails.english: We first go to Taichung, and then go to Kenting.

exampleDetails.chinese: 後來我發現太極很有趣。
exampleDetails.pinyin: hòu lái wǒ fā xiàn tài jí hěn yǒu qù。

exampleTranslations: We celebrate the Spring Festival up to the fifteenth of the first lunar month.

explanation: Post-verbal 到 indicates a time limit or endpoint. Structure: V + 到 + 時間.

english: to start to; to begin to
examples: 夏天一到，旅客多起來了。
他想到昨天的事就笑起來。

exampleDetails.pinyin: jià gé kāi shǐ zhǎng qǐ lái le。
exampleDetails.english: Prices have begun to rise up.

exampleDetails.pinyin: xià tiān yī dào， lǚ kè duō qǐ lái le。
exampleDetails.english: As soon as summer arrives, tourists start to increase.

exampleDetails.chinese: 他想到昨天的事就笑起來。

exampleTranslations: Prices have begun to rise up.
As soon as summer arrives, tourists start to increase.
When he thought of yesterday's matter, he immediately started laughing.
explanation: V + 起來 expresses inchoative meaning — a state begins or becomes noticeable.
